verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing describes custom automations and rules that move work forward, and automation that keeps Jira up to date as connected tools change. That is a first-party rule-based automation capability, but the evidence is thin and stays at marketing level. Missing for 10: documentation of event trigger types, conditions, and the action catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration that event-triggered rules work as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Connect your tools to any Jira workflow with automation. Whether your team is using Bitbucket, Slack, or any other tool, automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
